meta.name: nine-provinces-administration
meta.description: Use when establishing regional administrative divisions or designing taxation and tribute systems. Divides territory into nine provinces (州) with soil classification, graduated tax rates, tribute specifications, and water-route transport planning.

copy.tagline: 划分九州并设计贡赋与运输体系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在虚构或历史设定中规划区域治理与税收制度。
copy.tagline_en: Divide territory into nine provinces and design tribute and transport systems.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to plan regional governance and taxation in a fictional or historical setting.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按步骤将领土划分为九州，评估土壤等级，设定分级税率，指定各地贡品，并规划水路运输路线。
howto.when: 当用户要求建立行政区域或设计税收贡品系统时触发。

say.text: 将领土划分为九州，并评估土壤。
say.note: Claude 会执行划分和土壤评估步骤。

say.text: 为冀州设定税率和贡品。
say.note: Claude 会根据土壤和资源给出具体税贡。

say.text: 规划青州的贡品运输路线。
say.note: Claude 会识别水路并连接主河。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will divide territory into nine provinces, assess soil types, assign graduated tax rates, specify tribute items, and plan water transport routes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to establish regional administrative divisions or design taxation and tribute systems.

say_en.text: Divide the territory into nine provinces and assess soil.
say_en.note: Claude will perform delineation and soil assessment.

say_en.text: Set tax rates and tribute for Ji Province.
say_en.note: Claude will give specific tax and tribute based on soil and resources.

say_en.text: Plan tribute transport route for Qing Province.
say_en.note: Claude will identify waterways and connect to main rivers.
